name: Space Court
source:
As a newly appointed Judge, you will rule over Space Court and its denizens to keep the universe safe. Or possibly blow it all up. Either way, you’re tenured.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1323000/Space_Court/]Steam[/url]]
